2.209.16
Map.MapLegends
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.MapLegends element specifies a collection of map legends (specified by MapLegend
elements) to be drawn in a Map. This element is optional. This element is of type MapLegends.
The following is the parent element of the Map.MapLegends element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.MapLegends element.
 <xsd:element name="MapLegends" type="MapLegendsType" minOccurs="0" />
